question: Client assets per advisor across the five -- and is that comparison even valid?

So items: total client assets figures (various periods) — proxy for client assets; and Wealth Management representatives 15,950 (2020-12-31) — proxy for advisor count.

Is total client assets the right client assets measure? Client assets per advisor typically uses total client assets / advisors. For MS, advisor-led client assets ($6,631B at Sep 30, 2026) might be more appropriate with advisor count. Include both? So include total client assets (multiple periods) and advisor count.

Also the definition of advisor-led client assets ("client assets in accounts that have a Wealth Management representative assigned") — relevant definition.

Should I include the not-directly-disclosed statement: no per-advisor figure is disclosed, and no advisor count for recent periods. Actually the last item: advisor count only available at 2020-12-31 — that's a fact for that period (period coverage). But should I also note the firm doesn't disclose advisor count for recent quarters? The guidance says a fact for periods other than asked is still fact. So the 2020 figure is a fact but period 2020.

Hmm, but is the 2020 "Wealth Management representatives" the same as financial advisors? Might be closest. Include as fact since a4 says proxy named figure "the firm's count of financial advisors" — WM representatives is arguably that count. I'll label fact and note scope.

Maybe limit items to a reasonable set: I'll include 2026-09-30, 2026-06-30, 2026-03-31, 2025-12-31, 2025-09-30 total client assets; advisor-led client assets at 2026-09-30; representative count 2020-12-31; and client assets definition.

Should I include a definition item? definition field is per item; the client assets definition can be embedded in item for total client assets. Actually I'll add definition to the total client assets items: quote "(a) Client assets represent those for which Wealth Management is providing services including..." That is the firm's own definition. Good.

Item 1 quote: "Total client assets | $ 8,433 | $ 8,084 | $ 7,054 | 4% | 20%" — fine. value "8,433", unit "USD billions", period 2026-09-30, scope "Wealth Management".

Definition: "Client assets represent those for which Wealth Management is providing services including financial advisor-led brokerage, investment advisory, custody, cash management, and administrative services..." from MS-SUPP-2026Q3#37.

For item on advisor count: quote "Wealth Management representatives 15,950 15,469 15,468 3% 3%", value "15,950", unit "Wealth Management representatives", period 2020-12-31, scope "Wealth Management advisor-led channel"? The passage lists it under Advisor-led channel. Scope: "Advisor-led channel".
